thesis: The episode argues that large venture funds can achieve high returns by capturing a sufficient number of winners, as evidenced by a $1 billion fund that has returned 7X on Databricks and 5X on Coinbase. It further posits that private markets have evolved to create massive value, with 47% of total gains occurring between the Series A and Series B rounds, and 53% occurring from Series C onwards.
